title: Applicant Landlord: Clare Plasterers Union – Respondent Tenant:Mary O’Callaghan
text:
Residential Tenancies Board

Determination Order

Ref: DRO917-37411

In the matter of Clare Plasterers Union [Applicant Landlord] and Mary O'Callaghan
[Respondent Tenant] the Residential Tenancies Board, in accordance with section 121 of
the Residential Tenancies Act 2004, determines that:

1. The Notice of Termination served on 22 May 2017 by the Applicant Landlord on the
Respondent Tenant, in respect of the tenancy of the dwelling at 54 Crohan Lawn,
Shannon, Co. Clare, is invalid;

2. The Respondent Tenant shall continue to pay rent from 20 October 2017, the date of
the hearing, to the Applicant Landlord at the rate of €140.00’per week, unless
lawfully varied, and any other charges as set out in the terms of the tenancy
agreement, for each week or part thereof, until such time as she vacates the above
dwelling.

This Order was made by the Residential Tenancies Board on 15 December 2017.
